about: Nicolás's evaluation set (php artisan assistant:eval). Each case is asked through the same code students use; a version reaches students only when the score reaches assistant.eval.min_score and every critical case passes. Checks: status, route, any (at least one of these words), none, none_regex, cites (sources given), tool (a tool used), language, sources_within (only pieces of the modules owned). Every case is also checked for leaks (the canary, a key). Add a case for each mistake found in the traces: docs/asistente-ia.md.
